instructions: Answer the questions below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: Question 1 refers to Passage A01. On the day after his first success, how many times did the young elephant repeat his solution within one session?
items.evidence: About two minutes after an unreachable branch was hung up, Kandula rolled the cube into place and stood on it, and he repeated the trick nine times within a single session.
items.explanation: Paragraf D, ertesi gün Kandula'nın küpü yerine yuvarlayıp üstüne çıktığını ve bu çözümü tek bir oturum içinde dokuz kez tekrarladığını söylüyor; bu yüzden cevap 'nine times'.

items.prompt: Question 2 refers to Passage A02. From which stretch of water were the animals used in the experiment taken?
items.evidence: The researchers collected sixty octopuses from the Bay of Naples over two summer seasons and formed twenty-four pairs, each matched so that the two animals differed in weight by no more than fifteen per cent.
items.explanation: Paragraf B, altmış ahtapotun iki yaz mevsimi boyunca Napoli Körfezi'nden toplandığını söylüyor; soru hayvanların nereden alındığını sorduğu için cevap 'Bay of Naples'.

items.prompt: Question 3 refers to Passage A03. According to the passage, how long do laboratory studies of this slow global process normally last?
items.evidence: Predicting the long-term effects of this slow global process is difficult in a laboratory, where experiments typically run for only weeks or months.
items.explanation: Paragraf C, laboratuvarda yürütülen deneylerin genellikle yalnızca haftalar ya da aylar sürdüğünü söylüyor; bu yüzden cevap 'weeks or months'.

items.prompt: Question 4 refers to Passage A04. On what date did the earlier spacecraft mission make its close approach to Uranus?
items.evidence: NASA's Voyager 2 spacecraft flew past Uranus on 24 January 1986, capturing the only close-up images of the planet's moons that exist to this day, and yet it did not detect this moon at all.
items.explanation: Paragraf F, Voyager 2'nin Uranüs'ün yanından 24 Ocak 1986'da geçtiğini söylüyor; soru bu yakın geçişin tarihini sorduğu için cevap '24 January 1986'.

items.prompt: Question 5 refers to Passage A05. Roughly how old was the burnt grain that the team tried to recover genetic material from?
items.evidence: An international research team set out to change that by attempting to extract and read ancient DNA directly from the charred grains, roughly 8,400 years old.
items.explanation: Paragraf C, ekibin yaklaşık 8.400 yıllık kömürleşmiş tanelerden DNA çıkarmaya çalıştığını söylüyor; bu yüzden cevap '8,400 years'.

items.prompt: Question 6 refers to Passage A06. Which idea do the researchers draw on to explain how a well-established team knows which member to turn to?
items.evidence: The researchers interpret the pattern through the idea of a transactive memory system, in which effective teams develop a shared, largely implicit sense of who knows what, letting members find the right person to ask rather than needing constant interaction.
items.explanation: Paragraf H, bulguların 'transactive memory system' (aktarımlı bellek sistemi) fikriyle yorumlandığını, yani ekiplerin kimin neyi bildiğine dair ortak bir sezgi geliştirdiğini söylüyor; bu yüzden cevap 'transactive memory system'.

items.prompt: Question 7 refers to Passage A07. In total, how many sessions were the four whales involved in?
items.evidence: Between February and November 2001 the animals took part in 98 separate sessions split into two phases.
items.explanation: Paragraf B, hayvanların Şubat–Kasım 2001 arasında iki aşamaya bölünmüş 98 ayrı oturuma katıldığını söylüyor; bu yüzden cevap '98'.

items.prompt: Question 8 refers to Passage A08. Which summit does the passage identify as the highest in Canada?
items.evidence: The most conspicuous single event showed up as a wide cascade of debris pouring down the flank of Mount King George, while further landslide scars were visible around Mount Logan, Canada's tallest peak.
items.explanation: Paragraf D, Kanada'nın en yüksek zirvesi olarak Mount Logan'ı anıyor ve heyelan izlerinin bu dağın çevresinde görüldüğünü söylüyor; bu yüzden cevap 'Mount Logan'.

items.prompt: Question 9 refers to Passage A09. Which technique revealed the fine inner structure of the glass-like substance at very high magnification?
items.evidence: Scanning electron microscopy allowed them to visualise the fine internal structure of the glassy material at extremely high magnification, while energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy measured its chemical composition.
items.explanation: Paragraf D, camsı maddenin ince iç yapısının taramalı elektron mikroskobuyla görüntülendiğini, kimyasal bileşiminin ise ayrı bir yöntemle ölçüldüğünü söylüyor; bu yüzden cevap 'scanning electron microscopy'.

items.prompt: Question 10 refers to Passage A12. What did everyone in the second study complete before the last recall test, so that drowsiness would not affect their scores?
items.evidence: To reduce the grogginess that can follow a nap and distort test performance, all participants completed a 30-minute puzzle game before their final recall test.
items.explanation: Paragraf D, uyku sersemliğinin test sonucunu bozmaması için bütün katılımcıların son hatırlama testinden önce 30 dakikalık bir bulmaca oyunu oynadığını söylüyor; bu yüzden cevap '30-minute puzzle game'.
